title: Accessibility and WCAG Checks
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting accessibility and wcag checks to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Audit a screen against specific WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria, not general "looks accessible" impressions.
Compute and check color contrast against the 4.5:1 threshold for normal text.
Write alt text that conveys the information an image carries, not the word "image."
Ensure no status or meaning is communicated by color alone.
